ideal: Dependabot alerts, malware alerts and security updates are on; the dependency graph and review cover every manifest; updates wait their cooldown, then merge within days.

parts.ideal: Vulnerability and malware alerts on; no malware alert open; no vulnerability alert older than a week
parts.setup: Enable both in the organization's security configuration; malware alerts are off until asked for

parts.ideal: Security fixes arrive grouped; a new release waits 14 days; packages come from one trusted registry
parts.setup: In dependabot.yml: a cooldown, and a group that applies to security updates

quality: No open alert or malware, every dependency and action on its newest allowed release, packages only from trusted registries.
speed: An allowed update waits days, not weeks, and its pull request merges within the week.
consumption: Update pull requests and installs bill few CI minutes.
